citation: The main object of playing, I think, is not to be bored.
author: Buddy Rich
reference: Legendary big-band drummer, led the Buddy Rich Orchestra, widely called the greatest virtuoso drummer of all time. Source: 1980 interview with Les Tomkins, jazzprofessional.com/interviews/Buddy%20Rich_1.htm

citation: It's one thing to sit by yourself and bang; it's another thing to get on that bandstand with sixteen musicians -- now you have to assert who you are, what you are, and be able to play.
author: Buddy Rich
reference: Big-band drummer and bandleader (Buddy Rich Orchestra). Source: 1980 interview with Les Tomkins, jazzprofessional.com/interviews/Buddy%20Rich_1.htm

citation: You only get better by playing.
author: Buddy Rich
reference: Big-band drummer and bandleader (Buddy Rich Orchestra). Source: azquotes.com/author/12290-Buddy_Rich

citation: I keep time with the drums. I don't have no damn clock.
author: Papa Jo Jones
reference: Swing-era drum pioneer, Count Basie Orchestra, credited with modernizing the hi-hat/ride cymbal role in jazz drumming. Source: Modern Drummer, January 1984, moderndrummer.com/article/january-1984-papa-jo-jones

citation: The thing which made me think he was destined for greatness was his ability to play emotionally and from the heart.
author: Gene Krupa
reference: First superstar drum soloist, Benny Goodman Orchestra, popularized the extended drum solo in "Sing, Sing, Sing". Source: Down Beat, March 20 1958 (Dom Cerulli interview), reproduced at scottkfish.com/2015/10/19/gene-krupa-looks-at-todays-drummers-1958

citation: We're expected to be the rhythmic foundation.
author: Max Roach
reference: Bebop pioneer, played with Charlie Parker and Dizzy Gillespie, redefined the drummer's melodic role in jazz. Source: Modern Drummer, January 1979 interview, reproduced at jonmccaslinjazzdrummer.blogspot.com/2013/11/max-roach-interview-1979.html

citation: I think that the rhythm sections, drummers in particular, are the unsung heroes of the music. It's the rhythm section that has changed the styles from one period to the other.
author: Max Roach
reference: Bebop pioneer and civil-rights era jazz innovator. Source: quotefancy.com/max-roach-quotes

citation: I just wanted to hear something different -- to experiment.
author: Art Blakey
reference: Hard-bop drummer, led the Jazz Messengers for over 30 years, mentored generations of jazz musicians. Source: Modern Drummer (Chip Stern interview), reproduced at pas.org/art-blakey

citation: If you feel like tapping your feet, tap your feet. If you feel like clapping your hands, clap your hands... We are here to have a ball.
author: Art Blakey
reference: Leader of the Jazz Messengers, famous for driving, danceable hard-bop grooves. Source: en.wikiquote.org/wiki/Art_Blakey

citation: To be a drummer you also have to be a musician.
author: Ian Paice
reference: Drummer of Deep Purple, known for the double-bass-drum groove on "Highway Star". Source: zerotodrum.com/famous-drummer-quotes

citation: Drummers shouldn't just think of themselves as drummers. If you're going to be a musician, you should expand your horizons, compose things, and work with other instruments.
author: Stewart Copeland
reference: Drummer of The Police, known for reggae-influenced hi-hat grooves and rhythmic innovation. Source: zerotodrum.com/famous-drummer-quotes

citation: I believe most humans can be stirred to their cores by rhythmic drum patterns - it is surely the oldest music.
author: Neil Peart
reference: Drummer/lyricist of Rush, regarded as one of rock's most technically accomplished drummers. Source: Rhythm magazine, March 2014, 2112.net/powerwindows/transcripts/20140300rhythm.htm

citation: Drumming was the only thing I was ever good at.
author: John Bonham
reference: Drummer of Led Zeppelin, famed for his massive, behind-the-beat groove and feel. Source: edrumz.com/john-bonham-quotes-drumming

citation: The best drummers are the ones who can groove, plain and simple.
author: Dave Grohl
reference: Drummer of Nirvana, later frontman of Foo Fighters. Source: quotesanity.com/inspirational-drummer-quotes-find-motivation-and-encouragement-from-legendary-drummers

citation: I love being a drummer. Everyone thinks you're dumb. What they don't realise is that if it weren't for you, their band would suck.
author: Dave Grohl
reference: Drummer of Nirvana, later frontman of Foo Fighters. Source: elephantdrums.co.uk/blog/guides-and-resources/drumming-quotes-famous-drummers

citation: Good time should be the rule, not the exception.
author: Elvin Jones
reference: Drummer of the John Coltrane Quartet, pioneer of polyrhythmic, free-flowing jazz drumming. Source: "Thoughts by Elvin", wikijazz.substack.com

citation: That's what the drummer is supposed to do. Keep the time. If you can do something else besides that, fine. But the time is essential and non-negotiable.
author: Elvin Jones
reference: Drummer of the John Coltrane Quartet. Source: quotefancy.com/elvin-jones-quotes

citation: There ain't but one Tony Williams when it comes to playing the drums. There was nobody like him before or since.
author: Miles Davis
reference: Jazz trumpet legend and bandleader, said this about drummer Tony Williams (his 1960s quintet). Source: Miles: The Autobiography (1989), quoted in drummagazine.com/tony-williams-memories-of-a-drum-genius

citation: My ego only needs a good rhythm section.
author: Miles Davis
reference: Jazz trumpet legend and bandleader, pioneer of modal and fusion jazz. Source: spacial-anomaly.com/the-quotable-miles-davis

citation: The drums are the backbone of a band.
author: Questlove
reference: Drummer and bandleader of The Roots, Grammy-winning producer and DJ. Source: pudding.cool/2023/06/groove

citation: I try to be pretty. I play pretty and I always try to stay with the groove.
author: Bernard Purdie
reference: Session drumming legend, creator of the "Purdie Shuffle", played with Aretha Franklin and Steely Dan. Source: drummagazine.com/bernard-purdie-the-session-legend

citation: A good drummer has two legs and two arms and they're all playing different things.
author: Tony Allen
reference: Co-creator of Afrobeat alongside Fela Kuti, celebrated for his unique polyrhythmic limb independence. Source: independent.co.uk feature on Tony Allen

citation: Too much practise can be very damaging as a drummer gets to where he wants to play some lick he's practised on the gig whether it fits or not, instead of listening.
author: Ginger Baker
reference: Drummer of Cream, pioneer of extended drum solos and jazz-influenced rock drumming. Source: gingerbaker.com/blog/practising-makes-perfect

citation: First and foremost I am a drummer.
author: Ringo Starr
reference: Drummer of The Beatles, known for his feel-first, song-serving approach to drumming. Source: brainyquote.com/authors/ringo-starr-quotes

citation: It's been years and years and years I've been playing the drums, and they're still a challenge. I still enjoy using drumsticks and a snare drum.
author: Charlie Watts
reference: Longtime drummer of The Rolling Stones, admired for his understated swing-jazz-rooted groove. Source: rollingstonesdata.com/quotes/charlie-watts-on-playing-drums

citation: If you get too involved in the playing of the instrument itself, you forget that the whole purpose of what you're doing is to add to the music. There's more to music than having control over the instrument.
author: Steve Gadd
reference: Session drumming legend nicknamed "the Master of the Groove", played with Paul Simon and Steely Dan. Source: 1978 Modern Drummer interview, cruiseshipdrummer.com

citation: Make the metronome your friend, not your enemy.
author: Vinnie Colaiuta
reference: World-renowned session and fusion drummer, played with Frank Zappa and Sting. Source: quotefancy.com/vinnie-colaiuta-quotes

citation: Anytime you strike the drums, you have to be aware that you're creating a musical event.
author: Vinnie Colaiuta
reference: World-renowned session and fusion drummer (Frank Zappa, Sting). Source: elephantdrums.co.uk/blog/guides-and-resources/drumming-quotes-famous-drummers

citation: I hate solos, I hate shuffles, and I won't play in odd time. I'll just keep the groove.
author: Jeff Porcaro
reference: Drummer of Toto, one of the most sampled and studied groove/shuffle drummers in session history. Source: jeffporcaro.blogspot.com/2006/12/drum-interview.html

citation: The pocket holds everything together, and once you've set up that groove you can do everything that you want to do; that's what the funk is all about!
author: Bootsy Collins
reference: Legendary funk bassist, played with James Brown and Parliament-Funkadelic. Source: Bass Guitar magazine interview with Nick Wells, 2010, reproduced at guitarworld.com/features/bootsy-collins-james-brown-said-son-just-slow-down-and-give-me-the-one

citation: It don't mean a thing if it ain't got that swing.
author: Duke Ellington
reference: Pioneering jazz composer and bandleader, title/refrain of his influential 1931 swing standard. Source: arts.gov/stories/blog/2016/time-duke-ellington-said

citation: Ah, swing, well, we used to call it syncopation - then they called it ragtime, then blues - then jazz. Now, it's swing.
author: Louis Armstrong
reference: Foundational jazz trumpeter and vocalist, helped define swing feel and improvisation. Widely attributed to a Bing Crosby Show appearance and consistently quoted across multiple independent sources, but no primary audio/transcript has been located -- moderate confidence. Cross-referenced: chicagoacappella.org/program_notes/swing-swing-swing

citation: The drums are a part of me. They're a part of my heartbeat. They're a part of my sweat. They're a part of my tears.
author: Sheila E.
reference: Percussionist and drummer, Prince's musical director and drummer, worked with Marvin Gaye and Beyoncé. Source: quotesanity.com/percussion-quotes

citation: Rhythm is something that everyone has, whether you're aware of it or not.
author: Sheila E.
reference: Percussionist known as "the Queen of Percussion", Prince's longtime musical director. Source: masterclass.com/classes/sheila-e-teaches-drumming-and-percussion

citation: If you can describe it, it ain't funky!
author: Prince
reference: Multi-instrumentalist funk/pop icon, renowned for tight, groove-driven bands -- moderate confidence, a stage saying widely and consistently attributed to Prince (e.g. via Prince's official Facebook page) rather than a single pinned interview transcript. facebook.com/prince

citation: To me, the most important tool is not a physical or a technical one. It's more of a cerebral one. It's your brain.
author: Mike Portnoy
reference: Progressive rock drummer, co-founder of Dream Theater, known for rhythmic complexity and odd-time mastery. Source: azquotes.com/author/74855-Mike_Portnoy

citation: Music is the tool to express life - and all that makes a difference.
author: Herbie Hancock
reference: Jazz pianist and bandleader, pioneer of jazz-funk groove (Head Hunters) and modal jazz with Miles Davis. Widely and consistently quoted across independent sources, but no single primary interview transcript located -- moderate confidence. Source: azquotes.com/author/6200-Herbie_Hancock

citation: A genius is the one most like himself.
author: Thelonious Monk
reference: Pioneering bebop pianist and composer, known for his idiosyncratic rhythmic phrasing. Source: goodreads.com/author/quotes/237309.Thelonious_Monk

citation: Swing is a good example of an effective use of technology in music because it provides a musical feel that would otherwise be very difficult to play live, but you still have to be a creative human to play in the part yourself.
author: Roger Linn
reference: Inventor of the LM-1, LinnDrum, and MPC drum machines that shaped hip-hop and electronic production. Source: MusicRadar interview, musicradar.com/news/music-tech-legend-roger-linn-i-rarely-listen-to-anything-with-drum-machines-in-it

citation: When a real drummer plays a great-sounding groove containing 16th-note hi-hats, he varies the loudness of each hi-hat hit in a way that he has developed over years of practice.
author: Roger Linn
reference: Inventor of the LM-1, LinnDrum, and MPC drum machines. Source: Attack Magazine interview, attackmagazine.com/features/interview/roger-linn-swing-groove-magic-mpc-timing

citation: If the note dynamics and swing are right, then the groove works best when the notes are played at exactly the perfect time slots.
author: Roger Linn
reference: Inventor of the LM-1, LinnDrum, and MPC drum machines. Source: Attack Magazine interview, attackmagazine.com/features/interview/roger-linn-swing-groove-magic-mpc-timing

citation: When I make my music, I want people to feel what I feel, I want them to feel that energy. That's all it is, because I make it straight from the heart.
author: J Dilla
reference: Legendary hip-hop producer, pioneer of humanized MPC swing ("Dilla Time"). Source: 2003 Y'skid interview (Netherlands), as quoted at zachpartin.com/j-dilla-quote-dj-mix -- moderate confidence, sourced via secondary write-up of the interview rather than an independently re-verified transcript.

citation: Once you free your mind about a concept of harmony and of music being 'correct,' you can do whatever you want.
author: Giorgio Moroder
reference: Father of electronic disco and synth-pop production ("I Feel Love"). Source: en.wikiquote.org/wiki/Giorgio_Moroder

citation: I grew up on sample-based music. Breakbeats are the foundation of what I do.
author: DJ Shadow
reference: Sample-based production pioneer ("Endtroducing....."). Source: Tape Op interview, tapeop.com/interviews/11/dj-shadow

citation: I don't practice. It's a gift. It's talent. Obviously, I do it all the time so it's like I'm practicing, but that's just what I do.
author: AraabMuzik
reference: MPC finger-drumming virtuoso known for lightning-fast pad performances. Source: Pitchfork interview, pitchfork.com/features/interview/8770-araabmuzik

citation: I'm a musician: I play piano and drums, I read notes, I write music.
author: AraabMuzik
reference: MPC finger-drumming virtuoso. Source: Pitchfork interview, pitchfork.com/features/interview/8770-araabmuzik

citation: My concept has always been to get the feel from all drum machines simultaneously, not just one feel from one drum machine. I try to connect all the feels so that they accent and bounce off of each other.
author: Derrick May
reference: Detroit techno originator, one of the genre's three founding "Belleville Three" producers. Source: Music Technology magazine, November 1990, reproduced at muzines.co.uk/articles/techno-rhythim/452

citation: Without rhythm, it ain't worth living.
author: Mickey Hart
reference: Grateful Dead drummer and author of "Drumming at the Edge of Magic," a leading voice on rhythm and world percussion. Source: Insomniac Magazine, quoting Hart's appearance in Skrillex's Bonnaroo SuperJam documentary -- note: this line is widely misattributed to Skrillex online, but the source explicitly credits Mickey Hart. insomniac.com/magazine/quotes-of-wisdom-from-the-new-skrillex-bonnaroo-documentary

citation: Swing recognize swing.
author: Kaytranada
reference: Grammy-winning producer/DJ known for groove-driven house and hip-hop. Source: Soundfly/Flypaper, flypaper.soundfly.com/produce/talking-points-kaytranada-explains-get-outside-your-vacuum

citation: For records like 'Lord Knows' the Drake record, people think it's me playing drums, but it's just me programming the drums to feel like they're live.
author: Just Blaze
reference: Hip-hop producer known for Jay-Z, Beyonce, and Drake productions. Source: Tape Op bonus interview, tapeop.com/interviews/101/just-blaze-bonus

citation: I just feel like when I'm playing an instrument I understand why a lot of musicians are spiritual... It's watching the fingers, like, I'm not doing this anymore.
author: Flying Lotus
reference: Electronic/beat producer, founder of Brainfeeder. Source: imdb.com/name/nm2196468/quotes

citation: I just follow his rhythm.
author: Timbaland
reference: Hip-hop/R&B producer known for rhythmic innovation, longtime Jay-Z collaborator (remark made about Jay-Z's flow). Source: ambrosiaforheads.com/2018/01/timbaland-jay-z-production-beats-video

citation: It makes you feel good when you hear it... they make me feel good and make me want to put them together and let other people hear it.
author: Pete Rock
reference: Legendary hip-hop producer and sampling pioneer ("Soul Brother #1"). Source: illmuzik.com interview, illmuzik.com/threads/pete-rock-interview.4301

citation: It's the feeling. It's something that you're trying to hear and feel as a producer that the artist might not be feeling.
author: Dr. Dre
reference: Hip-hop producer and West Coast beat-making pioneer (N.W.A, The Chronic). Source: "Dr. Dre Teaches How To Make Beats In 5 Steps" video

citation: It's feeling, an equality, don't question yourself about that. You know what feels good and that's what works, what comes from the heart reaches the heart.
author: Terry Lewis
reference: Producer, one half of Jam & Lewis (Janet Jackson, SOS Band, Flyte Tyme). Source: Red Bull Music Academy lecture transcript, redbullmusicacademy.com/lectures/jam-lewis-lecture

citation: If it makes them move a certain way, ah the groove's not right.
author: Terry Lewis
reference: Producer, one half of Jam & Lewis. Source: Red Bull Music Academy lecture transcript, redbullmusicacademy.com/lectures/jam-lewis-lecture

citation: They became great drum machine programmers because nobody can program a drum machine like a drummer. Because they understand.
author: Terry Lewis
reference: Producer, one half of Jam & Lewis. Source: Red Bull Music Academy lecture transcript, redbullmusicacademy.com/lectures/jam-lewis-lecture

citation: Just having music in my head all the time. Always having some type of rhythm going in my head. See I'm into the art and craft of it all.
author: Pete Rock
reference: Legendary hip-hop producer and sampling pioneer ("Soul Brother #1"). Source: illmuzik.com interview, illmuzik.com/threads/pete-rock-interview.4301
